newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat to mark, down vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat to mark, down vs dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 994-995.30 per mark, unchanged from the opening, after very thin interbank trade and amid strong foreign currency supply after introduction of a currency board system, dealers said.
* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark as anchor currency under an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism, know as currency board, launched on July 1.
* The central bank was seen as a main foreign currency bidder as it bought marks at 995 levs, traders said.
* Under the currency board system the Bulgarian National Bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks, the anchor currency, at a bid of 995 levs and an ask of 1,000.
* The lev fell to 1,751-1,754 per dollar from the opening's 1,750-1,751 in line with mark losses against the dollar on international markets.
